name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for my home addition?
description: Choose a contractor based on experience, references, licensing, insurance, transparent communication, and quality craftsmanship.

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for my home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor, consider their experience with home additions, especially in your local area. Look for a company with strong references, proper licensing, and insurance. Transparent communication, a clear project proposal, and a commitment to quality craftsmanship are also key factors. Frasheski Construction offers these assurances for your project.
